updates.evidence: Frozen round-006 hostile worlds now distinguish process independence from evidence-lineage independence. Shared canonical ancestry reduces full independent-flat credit; disjoint complete lineages receive separate credit; missing lineage remains partially identified.
updates.implementation: ResearchRound.evidence_lineage + lineage_complete, SaturationTracker.independence_diagnostic(), exact maximum disjoint-lineage subset up to a configured limit and explicit conservative lower-bound fallback above it.
updates.remaining_gap: Canonical lineage identity is assumed. Alias/version normalization and graded dependence strength are separate open child fibers.

updates.evidence: GitHub documents pull_request GITHUB_SHA/ref as the synthesized merge branch while workflow/check-suite APIs expose the source head_sha; the preserved round-005 merge revision has base and source as distinct parents.
updates.remaining_gap: Need trusted parent-owned attestation of source, base, integration tree/revision and executed revision at evaluation time. Do not infer exact executed-subject authority from source head alone.

updates.problem: The same dataset, sample, benchmark or derived artifact can appear under different URLs, DOIs, repository paths, dataset names or versions. Exact string-disjoint lineage IDs can therefore create false independence.
updates.target: Build an evidence-identity ledger with canonical entity/version IDs, alias/specialization relations, and cannot-check states when identity cannot be resolved.
required_known_answer_worlds: two aliases of the same dataset version collapse before independence counting
two genuinely different versions with overlapping records preserve an overlap coordinate rather than forced same/different
derived datasets retain ancestry to their common raw source
unresolved alias identity blocks full independence instead of guessing

updates.problem: Shared ancestry proves that full independence is not established, but it does not identify the magnitude of dependence or incremental information.
updates.target: Only when the domain supplies covariance/sample-overlap/causal-hierarchical structure, estimate effective evidence contribution; otherwise retain the conservative full-independent lower bound.
required_known_answer_worlds: duplicate analysis of identical observations adds zero effective sample independence
partially overlapping samples produce intermediate dependence when overlap is known
shared upstream calibration with otherwise disjoint samples is represented without arbitrary fractional credit
